description: The .repo-checker.json file: what repo-check should know about a project, it overrides what repo-check detects

$schema.description: The schema of this file, for the autocompletion of your editor

canAutoMergeDeps.description: Renovate may merge the dependency updates on its own

isCli.description: The project is a CLI, meant to be run in a terminal

isModule.description: The project is an ESM package, "type": "module"

isPublishedPackage.description: The project is published to npm, its scripts run npm publish

isUsingBun.description: The project uses Bun as runtime or package manager

isWebPublished.description: The project is published as a website or web app, so its README shows a "Website up" badge

license.description: The license the project must declare, like MIT or GPL-3.0

maxSizeKo.description: The maximum size of the main file of the package, in Ko

webUrl.description: The url of the published website

title: repo-check project config
